target: standalone CLI on local Windows; desktop/Web builds not verified

fields.hookEventName/hook_event_name,sessionId/: contract BaseHookInput; payload createCompatibleHookStdin preserves native fields and adds aliases
fields.toolName/tool_name,toolInput/tool_input,: contract PreToolUse/PostToolUse; payload lossless alias assignments; flow uses canonical tool names
fields.toolInput.command: bash BashInputSchema; name Bash is case sensitive and does not prove actual shell
fields.toolInput.file_path,toolInput.content: write WriteInputSchema; edit EditInputSchema uses file_path
fields.toolInput.patch_text: patch ApplyPatchInputSchema (not command/patch/input); structured patch header reader reused
fields.toolResponse/tool_response: flow runPostToolUseHooks runs after execution and serialization; payload adds alias
fields.toolResponse.files[].filePath,type,moveP: patch ApplyPatchOutputSchema; synthetic empty diff arrays only
fields.stopHookActive/stop_hook_active,response: contract StopHookInput; payload Stop branch; last_assistant_message may use responsePreview if responseText absent
fields.error,error_details,isInterrupt/is_inter: contract PostToolUseFailureHookInput; payload failure branch changes error from object to string and retains error_details
fields.hookSpecificOutput.hookEventName,permiss: output applyHookSpecificOutput; hooks deny example; postContext and lifecycleContext deliver context
fields.configuredEnabled,runtimeHooksEnabled,tr: trust evaluateWorkspaceHookEntry; trustStates WORKSPACE_HOOK_STATE_ADMISSION_MAP; zcode-untrusted is a synthetic trust-state excerpt, NOT hook stdin
fields.fixture_kind: fixture-only discriminator; no equivalent host field
fields.sessionId subagent_worker-1: subagent run creates a separate childSessionId using createSessionId(subagent_<agentId>); sample identifier synthetic

limitations: PreToolUse is decoded and can encode Claude deny, but no guard is installed because the selected Windows shell/backend is absent from hook input.
Project hooks require owner review/grant bound to declarations; changing executable invalidates prior digest trust; skipped SessionStart is not replayed.
No SessionEnd in the seven-event contract. Stop remains silent.
ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR does not redirect standalone runtime config or AGENTS.md. JSON.parse rejects comments and BOM; installer refuses them unchanged.
MCP enabled:false is preserved; features.mcp=true is only written by explicit MCP planning, never undone on uninstall.
Both project configuration files existing requires manual consolidation to avoid duplicate hooks/shadowing; uninstall covers both.

Skill files are managed separately; features.skill, skills.enabled and per-skill overrides remain user-controlled. Verify obituary source using zcode skills list --cwd <project> --json in a new process. No real ZCode client has been installed or executed.
